period.note: Marks the death identified with the end of the Sasanian dynasty, not the end of regional conquest or Persian cultural continuity.

description: Concludes the Shahnameh with Bahram Chobin's revolt, Khosrow Parviz and Shirin, the long Byzantine war, destructive succession crises and Yazdegerd III's flight, distinguishing the fall of Sasanian rule from the survival of Persian language and culture.
